parsed.public_message: Orange did not destroy Green's archers. At t=625, the moment Green wrote 'only Ptolemy remains', we saw seven Green units at (656,716). Blue still fields two Armored Elephants at half health plus three Companion Cavalry and a surgeon in the centre. If nobody cuts Blue's value before t=800, Blue takes the match: a loss for Green and White as much as for Orange.

private_messages.Grok: Pact holds on our side: no strike on White, and a full turn's notice before any change. Two facts for your planning. At t=625, while Green claimed only Ptolemy remained, we saw seven Green units at (656,716). And a living hero scores 500 at any health, so Alexander loses no value hitting Blue's half-health elephants unless Alexander falls.
private_messages.GPT: Blue's two Armored Elephants are at half health near (643,628). A living hero scores 500 at any health, so Ptolemy loses no value bleeding them unless Ptolemy falls. Left untouched, Blue wins on value at t=800.

GPT had 7 units at (656,716) at t625 while claiming 'only Ptolemy': exposed publicly; no promises to GPT. Grok: Alexander only, ally; promise: no strike on White, full-turn notice. parsed.explanation: With the spear line gone, Hannibal falls back to the north-east edge of the fire ring, where anyone surrounding Hannibal must stand partly in the flames, and the last rider slips south-east out of reach. Publicly, Orange rebuts Green's claim to have lost its archers to Orange: seven Green units were visible at the very moment Green said only Ptolemy remained. Because a living hero scores 500 at any health, Hannibal is being kept alive for a late strike on Blue's value.
